description: Null control: circumsphere radii of all Cys/His donor quadruples, testing whether the second site is statistically distinctive
code:
"""
Correcting a methodological artifact in my own metric.

Four points in general position always have an exact circumsphere, so "spread 0.00 A"
is guaranteed and carries no information. The informative quantity is the circumsphere
RADIUS: a genuine tetrahedral metal site must have radius ~2.0-2.5 A (Zn-S 2.3, Zn-N 2.0).

Null test: enumerate ALL quadruples of Cys SG / His N donor atoms in the human APOBEC4
model that are mutually within 8 A, compute each circumsphere radius, and ask where the
observed C28/C31/H34/C87 site falls. Repeat the same enumeration on APOBEC3A (4XXO),
APOBEC2 (2NYT) and AID (5W0R) as structure-level controls.
"""
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT='/agent/jobs/5a541e70-d6f7-48b5-be7a-399123e44147/provenance'
def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=240,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    out=[]
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if l.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")) and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            if chain and l[21]!=chain: continue
            try: out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                 xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
            except ValueError: pass
    return out
def circumsphere(P):
    # solve for centre c with |c-p0|^2 = |c-pi|^2  -> 2(pi-p0).c = |pi|^2-|p0|^2
    P=np.asarray(P,float); A=2*(P[1:]-P[0]); b=(P[1:]**2).sum(1)-(P[0]**2).sum()
    try: c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,b,rcond=None)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError: return np.inf,None
    d=np.linalg.norm(P-c,axis=1)
    if d.max()-d.min()>1e-6: return np.inf,None
    return float(d.mean()),c

def scan(st,cut=8.0):
    don=[a for a in st if (a['resn']=='CYS' and a['name']=='SG') or (a['resn']=='HIS' and a['name'] in ('ND1','NE2'))]
    byres={}
    for a in don: byres.setdefault(a['resi'],[]).append(a)
    keys=sorted(byres); out=[]
    for combo in itertools.combinations(keys,4):
        best=None
        for pick in itertools.product(*[byres[k] for k in combo]):
            X=[p['xyz'] for p in pick]
            if max(np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[j]) for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(4),2))>cut: continue
            r,c=circumsphere(X)
            if np.isfinite(r) and (best is None or r<best[0]): best=(r,combo,pick)
        if best: out.append(best)
    return out

rows=[]; hs_radii=None
for name,url,ch in [("APOBEC4 AF-Q8WW27","https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8WW27-F1-model_v6.pdb",None),
                    ("APOBEC3A 4XXO","https://files.rcsb.org/download/4XXO.pdb",'A'),
                    ("APOBEC2 2NYT","https://files.rcsb.org/download/2NYT.pdb",'A'),
                    ("AID 5W0R","https://files.rcsb.org/download/5W0R.pdb",'A')]:
    st=parse(fetch(url),chain=ch)
    hits=scan(st)
    rad=np.array([h[0] for h in hits])
    top=sorted(hits,key=lambda h:h[0])[:3]
    resn={a['resi']:a['resn'] for a in st}
    print(f"\n{name}: {len(hits)} Cys/His quadruples within 8 A")
    for r,combo,pick in top:
        lab="/".join(f"{resn[i]}{i}" for i in combo)
        print(f"   radius {r:5.2f} A   {lab}")
        rows.append(dict(structure=name,quadruple=lab,circumsphere_radius=round(r,2)))
    print(f"   median radius of all quadruples {np.median(rad):.2f} A; "
          f"fraction with radius <= 2.5 A: {np.mean(rad<=2.5):.3f} ({int((rad<=2.5).sum())}/{len(rad)})")
    if name.startswith("APOBEC4"): hs_radii=rad
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(f"{OUT}/table12_circumsphere_null.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
ax.hist(hs_radii[hs_radii<12],bins=40,color='#90a4ae')
ax.axvline(2.41,color='#2e7d32',lw=2,label='C28/C31/H34/C87 = 2.41 A')
ax.axvspan(2.0,2.5,color='#ffe082',alpha=.6,zorder=0,label='metal-ligand range')
ax.set_xlabel("circumsphere radius of a Cys/His donor quadruple (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("number of quadruples in APOBEC4 model")
ax.set_title("Null control: only one Cys/His quadruple in APOBEC4\nhas a metal-compatible circumsphere radius",fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()
